title: IOCTL codes
description:
Build and decode the control codes a driver and its client agree on.

```
IOCTL_ECHO = CTL_CODE(0x8000, 0x800, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_ANY_ACCESS) = 0x80002000
decode 0x80002000 -> device 0x8000, function 0x800, buffered, any access
```
hints: Put the codes in one header that both the driver and the client include (lesson 16.05).
Function numbers from 0x800 up are for your own use.
requirements: `ctlCode` with the layout `device << 16 | access << 14 | function << 2 | method`, as a `constexpr` function.
`static_assert` your codes so a typo fails the build.
stretch: Print a table of every code your echo driver defines.
